brief:
A boy from Hebron has described being subjected to mistreatment by Israeli soldiers and settlers, according to Shehab Wire. The youth detailed allegations of abuse inflicted during an encounter with members of the occupation forces and Israeli civilians in the area.

The account comes as Palestinian communities in the occupied West Bank continue to report incidents involving confrontations between minors and Israeli military personnel or settlers. Such reports have become routine in areas of friction between Palestinian residents and Israeli forces or civilian populations in the territory.
